body.notify: Extends Epic `complete-consistent-richer-code-index-one` (c2ba6fa6): adds a Story for complete call extraction and resolution in every parser, building on DEF-c2ba6fa6, Story s1's pending-row classes and code in src/indexer/parser/*.ts and src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts.

addedStory.title: Every supported parser records the calls its code makes, and calls resolve within a package
addedStory.userValue: Someone asking what calls a function, or a code review asking which tests reach a change, gets the true answer in every supported language, not only in TypeScript: Python and Go record calls at all, calls outside methods (class bodies, initializers, scripts) are recorded in every parser, JVM callee names match what resolution looks up, and calls between files of one package resolve without an import.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Python test function calling a function imported from another module, and a Go TestX calling a function in another file of the same package
acceptanceCriteria.when: the repository is indexed and the callers of the called function are requested
acceptanceCriteria.then: each test is returned as a caller, and the code-review grounding lists the test file in the function's testsReaching

acceptanceCriteria.given: a ScalaTest class-body test("x") { ... }, a Kotest FunSpec({ test("x") { ... } }) lambda, a Kotlin init block, a Java initializer block, a field or property initializer and a Python class-body statement, each calling a function
acceptanceCriteria.then: each call is a CALLS relation from the nearest enclosing entity (the class, variable or property), never dropped

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Java qualified call obj.method() and a Scala receiver call x.method(s), where method is defined on a class in the repository
acceptanceCriteria.then: the call resolves to that method, or is reported ambiguous with its candidates; it is not left unresolved

acceptanceCriteria.given: a JUnit test under src/test/java/com/x calling a class in src/main/java/com/x, and a Kotlin test calling a function in another file of its package
acceptanceCriteria.then: both calls resolve without an import

evidence.quote: Scope narrowed on the stakeholder's decision (2026-10-17, after LLD review rounds 1-3)
Python emits no general CALLS today
Go emits no general CALLS today

nextAction.description: Approve the HLD amendment (`AMD-c2ba6fa62a148ed1-7`) and the updated Epic, then run `design.story` for the new Story `s12` to produce its LLD.

feedback.author: Subho Ghosh (stakeholder, chat 2026-10-17)
feedback.comment: Boundary decision 2026-10-17 (s13 option A): s12's parser work also covers emitting a binding key with every call and type reference, in every supported parser, derived from the caller's own file without reading another file: (target file id, exported name) for TypeScript/JavaScript and Python (relative or path-mapped specifiers resolved to the target's absolute path; namespace imports and module-qualified calls likewise), and (package, name) for Go, Java, Kotlin and Scala (explicit or wildcard import, or the caller's own package for an unqualified call); plus classifying a call as external (bound to a module outside the repository) or unbindable (unknown receiver type, Scala implicits, computed dynamic imports) at parse time. s13 consumes these keys in its pending map. Build order: s1 -> s3 -> s2 -> s12 -> s13.
